## Decisions

- Original GLB engineer rendered on demand, with keyboard/touch rotation controls and a text fallback; never a raster avatar.
- Warm ivory, charcoal, plum, and restrained orange; quiet sticky top navigation.
- Four distinct interactive product studies, six secondary architecture diagrams, seven archive projects; all factual content and URLs preserved.
- Studies are explicitly illustrative rather than live application screenshots.
- Reduced-motion support, offscreen suspension, semantic server-rendered content, and visible focus states.
- Illustration palettes and physical lighting colors are intentionally local art direction. 21st review reported informational hardcoded-color notices only.
